_outputs_comment: ONLY copilot. The 'claude' adapter targets CLAUDE.md, which is hand-maintained project instructions loaded every session — SigMap must never write signatures into it. codex/gemini are unused here.
_exclude_comment: 'tests' is excluded from SIGNATURE EXTRACTION only: test files yield almost no signatures, yet each takes a file slot a source file needs. Test-coverage detection uses testDirs below and is unaffected.
_srcDirs_comment: Pinned because auto-detection is unstable here. src/ holds all shipped source.
_maxSigsPerFile_comment: Above SigMap's default of 25 so the largest modules are not cut off at the cap; the extra tokens are negligible.
_budget_comment: effective = clamp(totalSigTokens x coverageTarget, 4000, modelContextLimit x maxTokensHeadroom).
_strategy_comment: 'full' keeps one always-loaded file. Revisit 'per-module' only if the single file stops fitting the budget — it splits output per srcDir, which costs an extra lookup step per question.
_testCoverage_comment: Function-level tested/untested hints. Cheap and directly useful when deciding whether a change needs new tests.
_impactRadius_comment: Reverse-dependency hints in file headers ('used by: ...'). Worth the tokens in a codebase where placement/import direction is a hard rule.
